newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore prime minister to visit Benelux states.
newsitem.headline: Singapore prime minister to visit Benelux states.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will on Wednesday travel to the Netherlands and then visit Belgium and Luxembourg until October 16, a statement from his office said.
This will be his first official visit to the Benelux countries as prime minister. Goh will be accompanied by a delegation of Singapore business executives.
In the Netherlands, Goh will meet Prime Minister Wim Kok, the statement said.
The two men will have a round table discussion with the Singapore business delegation and Dutch businessmen at the Association of Dutch Enterprises.

In Brussels, which Goh will visit from October 12-15, he will meet Belgian Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene and take part in a business forum involving the Singapore business delegation and Belgian businessmen.
Goh will also address the Royal Institute of International Affairs and meet the president of the European Commission, Jacques Santer.
Goh will visit Luxembourg from October 15-16 and meet his counterpart, Jean-Claude Juncker.
